transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I suppose... occupational health sent me. They think I've gotten into this pattern where I just... push breakfast and lunch aside during my lab runs or exhibition work. And then, by the time I actually do eat, I just keep it to something very small and... controlled. So, that's why I'm here.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

I suppose... my clothes are a bit looser. And the numbers have just sort of... drifted down lately. But I don't really see it as a problem. 

To me, it’s just a sign that I’m staying focused. There's a lot of chaos at the lab right now, and... well, keeping things controlled just means I'm not letting all that stress spill over into my body.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

I... I don't know if 'afraid' is the word I would use. But... if the numbers on the scale go up, even just a fraction, I do feel this... sharp panic. It just feels like I'm losing the discipline I've worked so hard to maintain. So... yes, I prefer to keep it where it is.
Do you think your weight or body shape is a factor in how you see yourself as a person?

I suppose it is, yes. I... I don't really like to talk about it, but... when I look in the mirror before I leave for the lab, I don't see what other people seem to see. I just... I mostly notice my stomach, or my hips. And it just makes me feel like I look... careless. Like I'm an unserious person. So... I try to keep it all under control.
Do you feel like eating a normal or large amount of food would make you feel like you're losing control?
I... I suppose so. I just... I don't really like eating large meals. It just... it feels overwhelming. I prefer to keep my portions small and manageable.
Do you feel anxious when you're not in control of what or how much you're eating?
I... I don't really find myself in that situation very often. I usually just prepare my own meals, so... I don't really know if I would call it anxiety. I just prefer to handle it myself.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most people would eat in a similar time period?
No. I... I don't do that. Like I said, I prefer to keep my meals small. So... no.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating?
No. I... I don't think so. I'm always very aware of what I'm doing when I eat, so... that doesn't really happen.
Have you ever eaten an amount of food that you thought was excessive, even if it was not larger than what most people would eat?
No. I... I don't think I've ever felt that way. I just stick to my normal amounts, so... no.
Do you ever make yourself vomit or use laxatives after eating?
No. I... no, I don't do that. I've never done anything like that.
Do you think that if you gained a small amount of weight, you would notice it in the parts of your body that you mentioned earlier, such as your stomach or hips?

Yes, I... I suppose I would. Um... when I look in the mirror before heading to the lab, I don't... I don't see someone thin. I mostly just notice my stomach and hips, and... it just makes me feel like I look careless. Or unserious. So... yes. I would notice.
Do you believe that gaining weight would significantly affect how you evaluate yourself as a person?

I mean... yes. Like I just said, when I look in the mirror, I don't see myself as thin. If I gained weight... if my stomach or hips got larger, it just makes me feel like I'm careless. And I don't want to be an unserious person. So... yes. It would.
Have you ever eaten in secret because you were ashamed of the amount of food you were eating?
No. I don't really... I don't eat in secret. I just eat what I need to.
Do you worry that if you started eating more, you would not be able to stop?
No... not really. I don't think about that. I just... eat what I intend to eat, and that's it. I don't worry about losing control.
Do you think you would be unable to stop eating once you start if you didn't restrict your food intake?
No... I think that's pretty much what you just asked. I don't have an issue with stopping. I just... I eat what I plan to eat. That's all.
Have you ever eaten an amount of food that you considered normal, but then felt like you had lost control and eaten more than you intended?
No. Like I said... I don't lose control like that. If I eat a certain amount, it's because I planned to.
Do you believe your self-worth is closely tied to your weight?

I don't know if I'd use the term self-worth. It's just... when I look in the mirror before heading to the lab, I don't see someone thin. I mostly just notice my stomach or my hips, and... I feel like they make me look careless. Like an unserious person.
Have you ever eaten an amount of food that you considered excessive, even if you didn't feel like you had lost control?
No. I... I don't eat excessive amounts of food. I just stick to what I need for the day.
Have you ever had episodes where you ate a large amount of food in a short period of time?
No. I... I haven't. I don't really eat like that.
Do you think being thin is important to you?
I guess so. I just... I prefer to maintain a certain standard for myself. I don't really think about it in those terms, I just want to look presentable.
